provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative master pump, iteration 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: An empty Content-Security-Policy field value supplies no policy, so the missing-header rule must fire (the old check treated an empty value as a present header).

groundTruth.rationale: The response carries a Content-Security-Policy header line with an empty value. An empty policy is ignored by the browser, so the response enforces no policy and the protection is absent.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request; no server was contacted.
The case proves the empty-value normalisation on this observation; it does not prove exploitability of a policy-free page.
